propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment truncation at 32767 chars but jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable on DC instances, causing silent data loss when administrators raise the limit
comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but shorter than an administrator's raised limit are truncated and discarded without the author knowing the full text was lost
the comment sanitizer incorrectly reuses the description fitter logic, risking future changes to description fitting to silently break comment handling
configuration key comment_max_chars with default 32767 and range 0–2147483647 makes the DC comment ceiling settable per deployment
application-properties endpoint is admin-only (requires Administer Jira permission) so auto-discovery of the live limit from rebar's ordinary-user PAT is not viable
